title: raceTelemetry.ts: keep or delete

options.name: Keep raceTelemetry.ts as it is (unused in production, one unit test)
options.risk: Dead code stays in the money-path module tree. If a later change wires it in as written, the go-live review gets wrong post-hoc numbers (wethSaved = r1/100) and a signed sell is handed to the ordinary chain RPC through eth_callBundle (AUD-ANTIRUG-014). The 7-day dry run collects no race telemetry either way.

options.name: Delete the module and its unit test in the Phase 25 dead-code wave
options.risk: If Phase 32 (OD-19) wants race telemetry for the live gate, it has to be built again, against the relay and with correct math.

options.name: Rewrite it correctly and wire it into the dry-run path as evidence for the OD-19 live gate
options.behavior_impact: Dry-run triggers make extra relay and archive RPC calls.
options.risk: New code and new network calls on the anti-rug path; telemetry errors must never delay a live exit.

recommendation: delete-after-audit, unless the Phase 32 OD-19 discussion decides race telemetry is part of the live gate, in which case rebuild-for-od19 replaces it then.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract).
behavior_impact: Decides whether an unused telemetry module with known defects stays in src/anti-rug/.
needed_by: Before Phase 25 Wave 3 (may be batched into the Phase 24 discussion)
